_comment: Speaker registry for Region 1 story dialogue. Every dialogue node's 'speaker' must be an id here (lint_quests.gd). 'principal' = the 12 named cast in docs/regions/CAST_R1.md. 'display' may be a {token} filled from the dialogue ctx (procedural parents). 'voice' is a one-line direction for writers and VO.

mother.voice: Warm, practical, worries in lists; pride leaks out sideways.

father.voice: Dry, understated; old Guard spear-carrier; jokes when moved.

maren_coldbrook.role: Staff teacher, Old Mill Staff Yard; ex-Runeward officer
maren_coldbrook.voice: Clipped drill-yard commands; gallows humour about her missing arm.

bram_hollis.voice: Tired arithmetic. Counts guards, stones, miles. Decent to the bone.

idra_vell.voice: Quiet imperatives, dry wit, never wastes a word. 'Hm.'

odrin_thale.voice: Formal, cites the Charter by section; fussy, honest, secretly frightened.

rowan_ashby.role: Knight-captain of the Order of the Highwatch
rowan_ashby.voice: Seventy winters of cheer; talks to the wind; calls you 'young blade'.

lucan.role: Envoy of the Dawn Throne (Aurelis Patriarchate)
lucan.voice: Gentle, sincere, sunrise imagery; says 'friend' and means it.

harrok_ashmaw.voice: Short, blunt sentences; speaks of himself by name; dark, dry humour.

snikkit.voice: Fast, third person, italic emphasis; sees 'the purple' before anyone.

imra_solvane.voice: Merchant charm, sun proverbs, always one bargain ahead.

tamsin_reeve.voice: Gravel and grievance; 'Edge rules'; never apologises, never lies.

corin_vesk.voice: Scared, defiant, too honest for the job.

gilda_pennick.voice: Shaken, plain-spoken, angry at the right things.

king_aldric.voice: Measured, tired, listens longer than he speaks.

ancestor_stone.role: An ember speaking from a runestone (Ember Legacy)
ancestor_stone.voice: Warm, fragmentary, echoing; remembers feelings better than facts.

narrator.role: Stage directions shown as italic text
narrator.voice: Present tense, concrete, one image per line.
